author: solofor

sections.description:
SoloAutomation is a free WordPress toolkit by Solofor Teknoloji for SEO, media optimization, WordPress performance and WooCommerce operations.

Local tools work without a Solofor account. Every module is opt-in and disabled on installation. Store owners who choose to connect a Solofor account can also use supported e-invoice, order/refund transfer and SoloPrompt content workflows according to their account permissions and balance.

Core features

  • SEO title, meta description, search preview, social image and structured-data controls for posts, pages and products.
  • Conflict detection for existing SEO and cache plugins, plus WordPress sitemap compatibility.
  • Compatibility-aware asset, image, font and WordPress performance controls that preserve cart, checkout and account pages.
  • Recommended, Balanced and Ultra performance presets while preserving manual exclusions.
  • Original-preserving image optimization, optional WebP copies, background batches and one-click restore.
  • Optional WooCommerce product videos without forced autoplay.
  • Maintenance mode, quote-request mode, HTTPS guidance and WordPress mail/SMTP settings.
  • Read-only WooCommerce sales reporting, with optional Solofor order/refund transfer and e-document status tracking.
  • Review-gated SoloPrompt product copy and article drafts. Generated content is not published automatically.

SEO compatibility

SoloPrompt can apply reviewed content to supported Rank Math, SEOPress and The SEO Framework fields. AIOSEO and unsupported fields remain available through copy workflows. SoloAutomation does not output competing metadata while another supported SEO plugin is active.

Languages

The bundled interface is available in English, Turkish, German, French, Dutch and Arabic. English is the safe fallback for every other locale. The WordPress.org package uses the soloautomation-solofor text domain and remains compatible with community translations distributed through translate.wordpress.org.

External services

The free local SEO, cache and media modules do not require a Solofor account and do not contact Solofor merely because the plugin is activated.

If an administrator explicitly creates and configures a Solofor connection, the plugin communicates with the configured Solofor/SoloAdmin API endpoint operated by Solofor Teknoloji A.S. to provide the selected account-backed features. New installations use https://soloforadmin.solofor.com/; the connector also accepts a Solofor-owned HTTPS subdomain selected by the administrator. Depending on the enabled workflow, this may include:

  • Connector health requests containing a client identifier, timestamp, nonce and HMAC signature.
  • WooCommerce order/refund summaries and customer-supplied invoice fields required for the selected e-document workflow.
  • Bounded callback, queue and document-readiness metadata.
  • Reviewed SoloPrompt request data for product SEO, descriptions, taxonomy content or article drafts.
  • Bounded diagnostics submitted only when an administrator chooses to open a support request.

The plugin does not send data directly to OpenAI, does not store OpenAI or e-invoice provider credentials in WordPress, and does not store raw UBL, PDF/XML or provider response bodies. Disconnecting the plugin stops new connector traffic.

When an editor explicitly starts the optional SEO research action for a post, page or product, the plugin sends the entered keyword and selected language code to Google Search at https://www.google.com/search. It requests up to five public result links so the editor can compare headings and coverage. This request is not made on activation, normal page views or automatic schedules. The plugin does not send WordPress account credentials or unpublished article text to Google Search.

sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate SoloAutomation from Plugins > Add New.
  2. Open SoloAutomation and enable only the local SEO, Performance, Media or store modules you need.
  3. Install WooCommerce only for store, order, invoice and product-video features. Local SEO and media tools do not require WooCommerce.
  4. To use Solofor services, create the relevant store or content connection in your Solofor account and enter its one-time setup credentials in the matching settings form.
  5. Run Test Connection and Refresh System Health. Automatic order transfer remains off until an administrator explicitly enables it.
  6. Review AI-generated drafts before applying or publishing them.
sections.faq:
Is SoloAutomation free?

Yes. Local SEO, media tools, performance controls, HTTPS guidance and store modes are free. Optional Solofor AI, e-invoice credits and other account-backed services depend on your Solofor permissions and balance.

Is WooCommerce required?

No. WooCommerce is required only for store-specific features such as products, orders, invoice connections and product video.

Are optimization tools enabled automatically?

No. Modules and live-library operations require an administrator action. Image jobs preserve verified originals and provide explicit restoration. Existing browser or CDN caches may still need refreshing.

Does SoloAutomation replace my page-cache plugin?

No. The WordPress.org package does not capture or store complete page HTML. It detects common cache plugins and leaves their configuration intact while applying only the local performance options you explicitly enable.

Can I migrate from Yoast SEO?

An audited migration path is available for the documented Yoast SEO Free version. Original fields remain intact, existing SoloAutomation values are preserved, and unsupported meaningful settings stop automatic takeover. No full Yoast Premium, redirect or custom-schema parity is claimed.

Does WordPress store OpenAI or e-invoice provider credentials?

No. Provider credentials, AI wallet policies, invoice artifacts and billing rules stay in SoloAdmin. WordPress stores only the connection data required by the documented signed connector contract.

Does SoloAutomation publish AI content automatically?

No. Product, taxonomy and article results remain review-gated. Article creation produces a WordPress draft.

Does it store invoice PDF or XML files in WordPress?

No. Supported document downloads are proxied through SoloAdmin. WordPress keeps bounded status metadata, not UBL, PDF/XML bodies or raw provider responses.
sections.changelog:
0.7.5

  • Replaced Turkish gettext source identifiers with English source strings across the complete runtime package.
  • Rebuilt English, Turkish, German, French, Dutch and Arabic catalogs from the corrected source inventory.
  • Aligned Turkish terminology, sentence case and directory copy with WordPress.org translation guidance.

0.7.4

  • Added complete bundled interface catalogs for English, Turkish, German, French, Dutch and Arabic.
  • Made English the safe fallback for unsupported locales and removed embedded Turkish copy from the default listing.
  • Added localized listing copy and banner variants for all six languages.
  • Added six-language SoloWocommerce theme catalogs, localized video controls and an Arabic RTL presentation layer.

0.7.3

  • Completed uninstall cleanup for local-module, cache, media, SEO migration and plugin-takeover state.
  • Updated audited development tooling and verified compatibility with WooCommerce 11.2.
  • Re-ran the complete WordPress.org package checks, clean-install activation and focused runtime tests.

0.7.2

  • Hardened administrative requests, cache behavior, temporary state and prepared database queries for the WordPress.org review.
